reason: Primary purpose is a user-facing interface plugin: a right-side panel for running an auxiliary AI side chat in DeepSeek Harness and feeding results into the main conversation. Evidence consistently frames this as a panel-based workflow aid rather than code tooling or data transformation, with only optional follow-up behavior to route prompts and responses between sessions.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的网页插件，在主会话右侧提供独立侧边聊天面板，可将选中文本输入侧聊、独立讨论后再把回复带回主会话草稿或上下文。
summaries.en: dsh-sidechat adds a right-side panel in DeepSeek Harness for an independent side chat, letting users stage selected text, run separate conversations, and send side-chat replies back into the main thread.

capabilities: Creates and manages isolated side conversations linked to a main conversation
Provides a right-side web UI panel for composing and controlling side conversations
Transfers selected main-thread text into side-chat input for staged sending
Injects side-chat outputs back into the main composer or context view
Allows per-side-chat configuration such as model, effort, permissions, and workspace context

reasons.code: README describes a right-side side chat panel with per-conversation isolation, workspace context inheritance, and bringing replies back to the main conversation.
README states side chats are created and managed through host /sidechat/api routes via agent.followup and returned via agent.inject/composer integration.
package.json declares a web client/host plugin bundle with DeepSeek Harness runtime and host dependencies, indicating integration at web application level.
